title: Muge, Roda rule PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon Manila
summary: Kenyan long-distance runner Gilbert Muge and Filipina elite runner Jessa Mae Roda were the top performers of the PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon Manila on Saturday morning at the SM Mall of Asia Complex.
